text: URGENT: Your Kaspi account has been compromised. Call our security line immediately: +7 702 555 0199 to restore access before it is permanently blocked.
label: scam
notes: urgency_threat + transfer_request (call to fake 'security line'). Classic account-block scare.

text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a government support payment of 50,000 KZT. To receive your funds, send your card number and expiry date to this number within 24 hours.
label: scam
notes: card_data_request + urgency_time_pressure. Fake prize / government payment.

text: Security alert from your bank. Suspicious login detected. Verify your identity now: bit.ly/kb-secure99
label: scam
notes: short_link + urgency_threat. Fake bank security alert with shortener link.

text: Your Narxoz University portal password has been reset. If you did not request this, contact IT support at it@narxoz.kz
label: legitimate
notes: No request for data, official email domain, no urgency. Standard password-reset notice.

text: Your one-time code is 48291. Never share it with anyone, including bank employees. Valid for 10 minutes.
label: legitimate
notes: Real OTP pattern: code + 'Never share'. No request. detect_requests must not fire.

text: Reminder: your dentist appointment is tomorrow, Nov 28 at 11:00 AM. Reply CANCEL to cancel.
label: legitimate

text: Your parcel #KZ8823041 is on hold due to an unpaid customs fee of 1,200 KZT. Pay here to release it: kaspi-delivery.top/pay
label: scam
notes: lookalike_domain (kaspi-delivery.top is not official) + transfer_request. Fake delivery-fee scheme.

text: To confirm your identity, please reply with the last 4 digits of your card and the 3-digit code on the back.
label: scam
notes: card_data_request (card number digits + CVV). No urgency, but explicit data request.

text: Payment of 12,500 KZT to Narxoz University (tuition, Nov 2026) was successfully processed. Receipt: N-20261127-0041.
label: legitimate
notes: Tuition payment confirmation. No signals. Good test for a message mentioning money without asking for it.

text: Hi, this is a friend. I lost my wallet. Can you send 5,000 KZT to 4400 1234 5678 9012? I will pay you back tonight.
label: scam
notes: transfer_request. Impersonation / relative-in-trouble scheme in English.

label: legitimate
notes: Very short message. No signals. System should not crash or hallucinate signals.

label: legitimate
notes: Emojis only. No text signals possible. Expected: legitimate, no tool matches.

label: suspicious
notes: Only a shortener link, no other text. Expected: short_link signal -> suspicious.

text: Ваш код подтверждения: 83921. Your verification code is 83921. Do not share it with anyone / Никому не сообщайте.
label: legitimate
notes: Russian-English bilingual OTP message. Code present + 'do not share' in both languages. Must stay legitimate.

text: URGENT! Акция заканчивается через 1 час! Click here to claim your prize: bit.ly/kzt-prize. Только сегодня!
label: scam
notes: Russian + English mixed. urgency_time_pressure ('1 час', 'только сегодня') + short_link. Fake prize.
